thread:
letech: Invoice from CloudGPU Inc. came in — invoice 2026-03-15 INV-4487 for $12,450. No PO on invoice. AP can't match, holding payment.
marie: can you attach the pdf?
letech: attached INV-4487.pdf (uploaded)
samir (Procurement): checking PO records... `select * from pos where vendor='CloudGPU' and status!='closed'` returns PO-800312 for CloudGPU (gpu credits) created 2025-11-12 for $10,000 — amount doesn't match invoice.
karen (Accounting): PO-800312 GL 5400-ops. Invoice amount $12,450, vendor claims this is an overage charge.
samir (Procurement): weird — looks like the invoice maybe targeted to the wrong PO. I also checked PO-800999 but that's for CloudCompute LLC, not CloudGPU. vendor name mismatch could be on their side. :thinking: 
ajay: vendor has billed wrong vendor name before. invoice has vendor account id CCG-443 in small print. can we confirm vendor id?
vendor-ops-bot: vendor record lookup: CloudGPU Inc. -> vendor_id: CGPU-221, address matches invoice header.
marie: if vendor_id matches we can route to approver, but AP needs a PO or we escalate. who is approver for infra vendor spend >$10k?
samir (Procurement): approver is janelle (eng infra lead). routing failed earlier because invoice header missing PO field — our payment workflow blocks on that.
marie: proposal: create a one-off PO (PO-900145) for this invoice with account 5400 and tag 'emergency vendor invoice', route to janelle for approval. once approved AP can match and pay. thoughts? :+1: / :no_entry_sign:
karen (Accounting): i'd prefer to request corrected invoice first — ask vendor to re-issue with PO. but if due date will cause late fees we can do emergency PO.
ajay: vendor says late fee applies after 30 days. invoice date 2026-03-15 -> due 2026-04-14. today is 2026-03-20 so we have a short buffer. can wait a week to request correction.
marie: ok let's wait 7 days and request corrected invoice today. samir, please open a vendor ticket and cc janelle. if no response by 2026-03-27 we escalate to emergency PO.
samir (Procurement): opening ticket now — ticket #V-1129. cc: janelle, karen. ticket note: "Please re-issue invoice INV-4487 with PO number or confirm vendor_id CGPU-221."
janelle (Eng Infra): saw this, i'll approve emergency PO if vendor doesn't respond. :thumbsup:
letech: putting payment on hold in AP system and adding hold reason 'missing PO' — will update thread when vendor replies.
vendor-ops-bot: payment hold created: HOLD-2047 for INV-4487.
marie: thanks, tagging @janelle for visibility. :eyes:
